description: This file declares the Eos class, which is a task related to WebAudio playback in the Rialto media server. It includes class definition, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references several external interfaces and context objects.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Represents an End Of Stream (EOS) task for WebAudio in the Rialto media server, responsible for handling EOS events in the WebAudio playback context.

methods.name: Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos task with the WebAudioPlayerContext and a shared pointer to IGstWrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the EOS task, likely signaling the end of playback or performing cleanup.
